RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, September 8, 2011/Bhadra 17, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Civil Aviation; Development of
North Eastern Region; External Affairs; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Planning; Road Transport and Highways; Shipping;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Space; Steel;
Tourism; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
145
Report of the National
Transport Development
Policy Committee
*501. DR. JANARDHAN W AGH-
MARE: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per a report prepared by
the National Transport Development
Policy Committee, poor maintenance of
roads costs the country about Rs. 35,000
crore annually;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government/
NHAI on the report of the Committee;
(c) whether Government proposes to
take any effective measures to ensure that
the roads are maintained in an efficient
manner by changing policy etc.; and
(d) if so, further steps that Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Article 275(1) of the Constitution
*502. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether purpose of Article 275(1)
of the Constitution has been fully fulfilled;
and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Budgetary allocation to CIC
*503. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the budgetary
allocation to the Central Information
Commission (CIC) for the past three years;
(b) whether Government is aware that
the staff for the CIC is inadequate to
dispose of the pending number of cases;
(c) if so, whether Government intends
to increase allocation to the said Office in
the next year;

146
(d) if not, whether Government has
conducted a study of the bureaucratic
infrastructure in place at the CIC and
whether it intends to improve the same;
and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Establishment of Expressway
Authority
*504. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has proposed
to establish Expressway Authority, a novel
body to facilitate building of over 18,000
kms of roads catering to high speed traffic
on the pattern of National Highways
Authority of India (NHAI); and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the time-
frame proposed by Government for this
matter?
NOC for Navi Mumbai International
Airport
*505. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Environment
Ministry has given No Objection
Certificate for Navi Mumbai International
Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the status of this
project; and
(d) how much time it will take to start
this project?
Improvement in aviation sector
*506. SHRI A VTAR SINGH
KARIMPURI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
a road map for the development of civil
aviation sector as a whole for the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the steps taken to make air travel
affordable and hassle-free for the
passengers; and
(e) the details of other measures taken
to improve the efficiency of the aviation
sector with a view to meet global standard
and competition?
Construction of roads under EPC
system
†*507. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that projects
related to construction of roads in the
country would be made under Engineering
Procurement and Contract (EPC) system
in place of Annuity System;
(b) if so, the details thereof, System-
wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that road
construction under Annuity System was
costly; and
(d) if so, the fact thereof and extent of
reduction expected in cost in construction
under the present system?
Power generated by atomic energy
†*508. SHRI RAMCHANDRA
PRASAD SINGH: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

147
(a) whether it is a fact that electricity is
generated through atomic energy in the
world;
(b) if so, the percentage of electricity
generated from atomic energy in America,
England, Japan, Germany, Australia,
Switzerland, Iran, Gulf countries, China,
Pakistan, etc.; and
(c) the target fixed in India, in
percentage, for generating electricity
through atomic energy?
Planning process to reduce regional
imbalance
*509. SHRI MANGALA KISAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the planning process adopted by
Government to reduce the regional
imbalance in the country;
(b) the number of pockets/regions of
the country that have been identified as
most backward regions or underdeveloped
regions like Bundelkhand region in the
country;
